"""Single-agent review of closed normal-return evidence; no native rerun."""
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

root=Path.cwd();cache=root/'linux-kernel/.cache/x86_64'
archive=root/'linux-kernel/tools/process-memory/results/stage-3-caller-retirement'
reference=root/'linux-kernel/tools/process-memory/results/stage-3-prelude-stat'
began=time.monotonic()
def fact(raw):return dict(bytes=len(raw),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
def packed(name):return gzip.decompress((archive/(name+'.gz')).read_bytes())
def closed(base):
    manifest=json.loads((base/'manifest.json').read_bytes())
    assert set(manifest)|{'manifest.json'}=={p.relative_to(base).as_posix() for p in base.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    for name,expected in manifest.items():
        path=(base/name).resolve();assert path.is_relative_to(base) and fact(path.read_bytes())==expected
    return manifest
group=next(line.split(':',2)[2] for line in Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('0::'))
directory=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')/group.lstrip('/')
assert 'topal-bounded-' in group
manifest=closed(archive);report=json.loads((archive/'report.json').read_bytes())
assert report['passed'] and len(manifest)==1340
assert set(report['cohorts'])=={'initial','discovery','qualified'}
runs={label:json.loads(packed('matrix/'+label+'/run.json')) for label in report['cohorts']}
run=runs['qualified'];assert run['passed'] and run['exit_code']==0
assert set(run['validation'])=={'workspace-check','user-memory-models','process-memory-models',
    'default-ABI-fixture','format','Rust-file-ceiling'}
assert all(row['status']=='complete' and row['exit_code']==0 for row in run['validation'].values())
for name,count in [('user-memory-models',203),('process-memory-models',80)]:
    text=packed('matrix/qualified/'+name+'.stderr.log').decode()
    assert f'Ran {count} tests in ' in text and text.rstrip().endswith('OK')
assert len(report['sources'])==734 and set(report['sources'])==set(run['source_hashes_before'])
for name,expected in report['sources'].items():
    raw=packed('inputs/'+name)
    assert fact(raw)==expected and expected['sha256']==run['source_hashes_before'][name]
    assert (root/name).read_bytes()==raw
for label,old in runs.items():
    assert old['source_hashes_before']==old['source_hashes_after'] and not old['source_changes_during_run']
    assert old['driver_unchanged'] and len(old['cohorts'])==1 and old['cohorts'][0]['exit_code']==0
    assert set(old['source_hashes_before'])==set(report['sources'])
    if label!='qualified':
        changed={name for name,value in old['source_hashes_before'].items()
            if value!=run['source_hashes_before'][name]}
        assert changed==set(report['historical_sources'][label])
        for name,expected in report['historical_sources'][label].items():
            assert fact(packed('historical-inputs/'+label+'/'+name))==expected
            assert expected['sha256']==old['source_hashes_before'][name]
assert not runs['initial']['passed'] and runs['initial']['cohorts'][0]['readback']['exit_code']==1
assert 'ValueError: caller admission/result carry' in packed('matrix/initial/readback.stderr.log').decode()
assert not runs['discovery']['passed'] and runs['discovery']['cohorts'][0]['readback']['exit_code']==0
assert runs['discovery']['validation']['process-memory-models']['exit_code']==1
assert "ImportError: 'test_model' module incorrectly imported" in packed('matrix/discovery/process-memory-models.stderr.log').decode()
frozen=json.loads((cache/'caller-retirement-frozen-replay/replayed.json').read_bytes())
assert frozen['passed'] and frozen['archive_manifest']==fact((archive/'manifest.json').read_bytes())
assert frozen['qualified_reader_passed'] and frozen['original_reader_failure_reproduced']
assert frozen['discovery_failure_reproduced'] and frozen['models']==80
closed(reference)
prior_raw=(root/(str(reference.relative_to(root))+'-review.json')).read_bytes()
prior=json.loads(prior_raw);ref=report['compiler_reference']
assert prior['passed'] and prior['archive_manifest']==fact((reference/'manifest.json').read_bytes())
assert ref==run['compiler_reference'] and ref['review']==fact(prior_raw)
assert ref['manifest']==prior['archive_manifest'] and not ref['original_resource_accounting_complete']
assert ref['unchanged_relevant_inputs']==361
assert ref['compiler_passed']==383 and ref['compiler_ignored']==25
for name in ['manifest.json','report.json']:
    assert (archive/'compiler-reference'/name).read_bytes()==(reference/name).read_bytes()
assert (archive/'compiler-reference/review.json').read_bytes()==prior_raw
compiler=gzip.decompress((archive/'compiler-reference/compiler-units.stdout.log.gz').read_bytes())
assert fact(compiler)==ref['compiler_log']
assert re.search(rb'test result: ok\. 383 passed; 0 failed; 25 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out',compiler)
old_report=json.loads((reference/'report.json').read_bytes())
old_files=old_report['cohorts']['ordinary']['files']
objects=prior['artifact_review']['ordinary']['unchanged_objects'];assert len(objects)==15
old_sources=prior['artifact_review']['ordinary']['source_files'];assert len(old_sources)==6
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'linux-kernel/tools/process-memory'))
from readback_caller_retirement import readback
artifact_review={};returned_sites=[]
for label,case in report['cohorts'].items():
    qualification=runs[label];build=root/qualification['cohorts'][0]['builds'][0]
    assert len(case['llvm'])==7 and all(row['passed'] for row in case['llvm'].values())
    for name,expected in case['files'].items():
        assert fact(packed('native/'+label+'/'+name))==expected
        assert fact((build/name).read_bytes())==expected
    summary=case['summary'];assert json.loads(json.dumps(readback(build)))==summary
    assert summary['passed'] and summary['sampled_sites']==75 and summary['total_sites']==91
    assert summary['outer_adapter_samples']=={'80':72,'88':3} and summary['both_alignments_observed']
    assert summary['native_results']=={'0':67,'1':2,'2':1,'3':1,'4':4}
    assert summary['heap_blobs']==25 and summary['heap_blob_bytes']==3211264
    assert len(summary['controls'])==19 and all(row['rejected'] for row in summary['controls'])
    mm=summary['process_mm'];assert mm['passed'] and mm['cases']==4
    assert len(mm['controls'])==20 and all(row['rejected'] for row in mm['controls'])
    assert all(case['files'][name]==expected for name,expected in objects.items())
    assert case['files']['kernel.elf']==prior['artifact_review']['ordinary']['kernel']
    assert case['files']['static-elf-abi-fixture.elf']==old_files['static-elf-abi-fixture.elf']
    assert summary['kernel_sha256']=='b8212e5e9aca715d8db0d863cbc9655ed989c3884b938b57055c3e22e04d0a7c'
    sources={name:expected for name,expected in case['files'].items() if name.endswith('.c')}
    assert sources==old_sources
    bounds=json.loads(packed('native/'+label+'/frame-inspection.json'))
    assert bounds['user_extent_callers']==dict(complete_physical_bytes=4088,complete_stack_bytes=2280,
        inner_retirement_bytes=3952,outer_bytes=88,reserve_bytes=4096)
    assert bounds['syscall_adapter']['physical_retirement_bytes']==4000
    component=json.loads(packed('native/'+label+'/source-component.json'))
    frames={}
    for name in case['files']:
        if name.endswith('.su'):
            rows=[line.split('\t') for line in packed('native/'+label+'/'+name).decode().splitlines()]
            assert rows and all(len(row)==3 and row[2]=='static' and int(row[1])>=0 for row in rows)
            frames[name[:-3]]=sum(int(row[1])+8 for row in rows)
    assert frames==component['stack_frame_costs'] and component['mode']=='process-mm'
    assert 1024+128+frames['process-mm-cases']==component['conservative_user_stack_bytes']==1208<=2048
    value=json.loads(packed('native/'+label+'/process-mm-users/observations.json'))
    returned={row['site']['offset'] for row in value['caller_retirement']['records']}
    assert len(returned)==75 and returned.isdisjoint(summary['missing_sites'])
    returned_sites.append(returned)
    artifact_review[label]=dict(passed=True,unchanged_objects=objects,source_files=sources,
        kernel=case['files']['kernel.elf'],unchanged_application=case['files']['static-elf-abi-fixture.elf'],
        bounds=bounds['user_extent_callers'],user_stack=dict(frames=frames,bytes=1208,reserve=2048),
        sampled_normal_returns=75,outer_adapter_samples=summary['outer_adapter_samples'],
        native_results=summary['native_results'],heap_blobs=25,heap_blob_bytes=3211264)
assert all(sites==returned_sites[0] for sites in returned_sites)
assert 101781 not in returned_sites[0]
normal_union=returned_sites[0]|{101781};assert len(normal_union)==76
assert prior['caller_site_delta']['reached_sites']==89
scope=dict(normal_return_sites_this_cohort=75,normal_return_sites_with_prior_prelude=76,
    total_sites=91,historical_first_reach_sites=89,
    historical_unsampled_offsets=[88215,94687],
    scope='First normal return per sampled site only. Zero includes empty-range no-touch. The76return union and89historical first-reach census are distinct; neither establishes every argument/error/fatal/exception path or continuous loan lifetime.')
subprocess.run(['rtk','proxy','git','diff','--quiet','b754f06a159075a66c01ed509eab42a78b7cc6fd','--',
    'src','docs','se','spec','Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','scripts','AGENTS.md','linux-kernel/kernel',
    'linux-kernel/design','linux-kernel/tools/process-memory/results/stage-3-prelude-stat',
    'linux-kernel/tools/process-memory/results/stage-3-caller-site-union'],check=True)
resources={name:(directory/name).read_text().strip() for name in ['memory.max','memory.swap.max','memory.peak','memory.events']}
for values in [*(old['resources'] for old in runs.values()),frozen['resources'],resources]:
    assert values['memory.swap.max']=='0' and 0<int(values['memory.peak'])<=int(values['memory.max'])
    assert all(int(line.split()[1])==0 for line in values['memory.events'].splitlines())
receipt=dict(passed=True,archive_manifest=fact((archive/'manifest.json').read_bytes()),
    archive_report=fact((archive/'report.json').read_bytes()),qualification=run,
    artifact_review=artifact_review,caller_scope=scope,frozen_replay=frozen,
    historical_failures={label:dict(exit_code=runs[label]['exit_code'],
        resources=runs[label]['resources'],source_overrides=report['historical_sources'][label])
        for label in ['initial','discovery']},
    risk='High: security-sensitive ownership/retirement evidence. Single-agent authority/source/native-closure review plus complete byte reconstruction, native boundary observations, saved-record controls and full model discovery; no independent human security review.',
    resources=resources,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-began,audit_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),
    scope='Observation/readback/model-only increment; three complete ordinary VMs pass native checks. Original reader-vocabulary and test-discovery failures retained and reproduced, followed by fresh complete qualification. Six surrounding checks run fresh; earlier unchanged383compiler suite is referenced, not rerun. Original compiler-batch accounting gap remains. No production/kernel/C/core-language change, every-path/fatal/continuous/private-loan qualification, public activation or initial Linux completion.')
target=root/'linux-kernel/tools/process-memory/results/stage-3-caller-retirement-review.json'
assert not target.exists();target.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(passed=True,entries=len(manifest),sources=len(report['sources']),
    normal_return_sites=75,normal_return_union=76,elapsed_seconds=receipt['elapsed_seconds'])))
